append.detail:
── UNBLOCKED 2026-09-29 by LIVE-707 (ADR-1658). THE DRAFT: app/space-email-policy/page.tsx (served at /space-email-policy, noindex, not in the sitemap, not linked from the card or anywhere else). Hand that page to counsel. Its last section lists eleven open questions from what Space email actually does today (sender of record and controller or processor, whose postal address, replies to a no-reply sender, the event host exception, a join as consent, a complaint stopping every Space, enforcement with no automatic threshold, the prohibited list, tracking consent, acceptance by name, the appeal reply time) and one placeholder for the owner: the appeal reply time in section 10. THE ASK NOW: have counsel review the draft; then an agent removes the draft banner and the questions, lets it be indexed and sitemapped, and links it from the Turn on email card, which closes this row.

── CLOSED 2026-09-30 as RULED. OWNER RULING 2026-09-30 ~01:35Z (multiple choice, recorded by HYG-156, ADR-1672): "Ship without counsel review". No counsel review. The build is LIVE-729, a separate PR: it publishes the LIVE-707 draft as the policy (the draft banner and the open questions come off, it is indexed and sitemapped) and links it from the Turn on email card. This row is the ruling only and closes on it.
